answer_4.quote: human players annotate every message that they receive or send: they annotate each outgoing message for whether it is a lie (truth/lie/neutral options), and they annotate each incoming message for whether they perceive it as a lie (truth/lie options)
answer_4.guideline: Annotate outgoing messages as truth, lie, or neutral; incoming messages as truth or lie.
